what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Malaysia, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 15286 in 2019 to 609 in 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Malaysia list floods, storms and mass movements.
UCDP records one armed conflict for Malaysia: over Sabah territory with the Sultanate of Sulu in 2013.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 and 2023.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 148207 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Malaysia.
